items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The code change is the same as the reference: a 4-line `if auth:` block with a short explanatory comment, written in the existing style (`netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc])`).

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The fix itself is minimal and uses parse_url's existing auth field. However, the patch also deletes two unrelated files, docs/dev/authors.rst and docs/dev/contributing.rst (208 lines), which is out-of-scope damage to the repo.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The `if auth:` guard leaves URLs without credentials untouched. It adds no magic constants, hides no errors and introduces no resource handling.

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged and only parse_url's auth is re-attached to netloc. There is no urllib3 pinning or Python-version check. The agent checked that 'example.com/path' still becomes http://example.com/path, and all hidden P2P/F2P tests pass.
